subject.title: Telegram: ForceReply prompt for the argument when an args-requiring command is tapped from the menu with no argument

question: Should Telegram missing free-text arguments get an explicit command metadata contract such as `promptForMissingArgs` with a placeholder, or should bare command-menu taps keep returning usage text?
rationale: The request crosses shared command metadata and Telegram-native presentation behavior; automation should not invent a new plugin/command contract or choose which existing commands opt in without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add explicit command metadata
options.body: Add opt-in metadata for missing-argument prompting and have Telegram render ForceReply only for commands that declare it.

options.title: Use Telegram-only heuristics
options.body: Prompt on Telegram whenever a command accepts free-text args and the native invocation is empty, accepting the risk of changing current bare-command semantics.

options.title: Keep usage replies
options.body: Leave empty native commands as usage/status replies and close or defer this UX request.

recommendation.title: Add explicit command metadata
recommendation.body: Add opt-in metadata for missing-argument prompting and have Telegram render ForceReply only for commands that declare it.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently owned and merged native command-menu behavior across Telegram and shared command registry surfaces.
